"''Having a hard time scanning in these corridors.|Sergeant CS-812 and 398|}} '''398''' was a [[human]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] who served in the [[First Order]]. They were one of the many [[trooper]]s stationed on the ''[[Colossus]]'' refueling station, and accompanied [[Sergeant]] [[CS-812]] to chase down [[CS-515]], who [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] believed to have erratic programming. In reality, it was [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] wearing CS-515's [[First Order stormtrooper armor|armor]] after the trooper had been knocked unconscious. Xiono managed to [[Theft of First Order data rod|escape]] and put the [[armor]] back onto CS-515, who was tracked down by 398 and taken away for reconditioning. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The New Trooper}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=398 |fr=398 |ja=398 }} [[Category:Colossus garrison members]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
